newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy repeated.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities said Friday it reiterated its buy rating on Tribune Co.

-- Earlier, Tribune said it reached an agreement for Emmis Broadcasting Corp to manage WQCD, an FM radio station in New York, for up to three years. After that, Emmis has the right to purchase the station. Tribune said it will seek to identify a suitable property to be acquired in an exchange transaction.
-- Prudential said it estimates the value of the transaction at $140 million to $160 million, which would be 17.5 to 20 times WQCD's 1996 cash flow of $8 million.
-- Tribune shares were unchanged at 43-1/2, near its 52-week high.
-- "The (Tribune) shares have rallied in recent weeks, but we still believe they represent a compelling value for long-term oriented investors," Prudential said in a report.
